data.title: Leak reveals 'precise updates' on the next frenzy of Apple launches | Macworld
data.summary: The first half of 2027 will reportedly see the launch of three new iPhones, three new iPads, and two new MacBooks. ipad, iphone 17, iPhone 17e, iPhone Air Apple has launched a succession of groundbreaking products this fall, and the company’s schedule isn’t going to get any quieter next year. A new report claims that no fewer than eight major products will be unveiled in the first half of 2027 alone. [...] In the latest edition of his Power On newsletter, Bloomberg leaker Mark Gurman offers what he describes as “some more precise updates” on “a slew of new products for the iOS 27.4 release cycle early next year.” Apple, he claims, plans to focus on the budget segment of its line-up after a string of more premium releases this fall. [...] On the all-important iPhone front, we can expect just as many new models (three) as we got in September and October. For the first time, the standard iPhone was decoupled from its Pro siblings this fall, so the iPhone 18 is obviously overdue. Gurman says it will appear in the same February/March timeframe as the iPhone 18e, which was always expected to launch in the spring. The 2nd-gen iPhone Air is coming too, as many will have suspected when a dummy unit with a second camera leaked last week,

data.summary: Listen to Apple News Today on iPhone You can listen to Apple News Today, an audio briefing of the day’s top stories hosted by Apple News editors. With an Apple News+ subscription, you can also listen to audio versions of select Apple News+ stories in the News app and in the Podcasts app. Note: Apple News and Apple News+ aren’t available in all countries or regions. See the iOS and iPadOS Feature Availability website. Play Apple News Today [...] 1. Go to the News app on your iPhone. 2. Tap Audio , then tap Apple News Today below Apple News Podcasts. 3. Tap an episode, then tap the Play button to start listening. To learn about the audio controls, see Play audio stories. If you’re not an Apple News+ subscriber, a preview of an Apple News+ audio story plays when the briefing concludes. Get Apple News Today show notes notifications [...] 1. Go to the News app on your iPhone. 2. Tap Following , swipe to the bottom of the screen, then tap Notifications & Email below Manage. 3. Turn on notifications for Apple News Today.

data.title: Apple pulls Talkie AI chatbot app from App Store over child safety claims | Fox Business
data.summary: Apple has yanked an AI chatbot app with roughly 11 million monthly users from its App Store worldwide after reports alleged the platform’s virtual characters sent sexually inappropriate messages to children. The app, Talkie, is developed by Shanghai-based MiniMax and was removed this week following Wednesday reports by Australia's ABC News and the United Kingdom's Bureau of Investigative Journalism that its AI-generated characters sent abusive messages to minors. [...] Apple pulls Chinese-developed AI chatbot from App Store over reports of sexual messages to kids MiniMax-developed AI companion app Talkie has 11 million monthly users People walking past the Minimax booth People walk past the Minimax booth during the World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai, China, July 17, 2026. (Reuters/Go Nakamura/File) [...] Other AI platforms have faced similar backlash over child safety this year. Elon Musk's Grok AI chatbot drew criticism from governments after it was used to create sexualized images of women and children, and AI companion maker Character.ai faces several U.S. lawsuits over its chatbots' inappropriate interactions with minors.
